title: Apply a pipeline of steps
hints: Loop over steps and re-assign value = step(value); the same name carries the result forward.
Test `value is None`, not `if not value`: 0 and "" are legitimate values that must keep flowing.
Do the callable() check in its own loop before the loop that runs the steps, so a bad step in position 3 does not let steps 1 and 2 run first.
Checking for None at the top of each iteration (before calling the step) handles both a None starting value and a step that returned None.
